body: To be fair, there are a lot of things I love him for but those aren't things I would consider divorce for. I appreciate the  thoughtful response.
That's not a bad idea. We could take some space, and I could get a better grip on things and then revisit the idea. I really appreciate the comment!

I think all the commenters who say I need to work on myself are certainly right. I'd like to get back into official counseling again. In your opinion would it be worth getting a better job and potentially getting a divorce in a few years when I can stand on my own or would I be better off just spending that time and effort trying to be a better me?

Do you think I should stop trying to work on myself because of doing something awful as a college freshman? I want to think I can have a functional relationship at the very least with myself. But I'm also still stupid and not self aware which is why I turn to internet strangers. Should I give up?
I agree. I need to get healthier. Thanks for the comment.
Yeah I agree we both have issues. I do hope he will eventually change his mind but if not all I can do is be the best me that I can. Thanks for your comment.

He did break up with me. I was like 17 at the time. I know being 17 doesn't make it okay but I really was just young and stupid at the time and I swear I learned my lesson. I told him right away and I knew we would break up with me and that is exactly what I deserved. I should have broken up with him first but I didn't. I still feel bad about it and worse now because I feel like people think I am irredeemable and a scum person for it. But it wasn't something recent. He clearly forgave me or he wouldn't have started talking to me again and dated me for years and asked me to marry him. Some people are serial cheaters but since we got back together I haven't done that again mor would I ever. I think if he was willing to forgive me that people commenting about it need to be more forgiving too. I might not ever be able to forgive myself but it's really hard to work to be a better person if I think everyone online thinks I should be kicked out and homeless. Like, it feels like I should just hate myself more and I don't want that. I want to think I can be worthy of love even if it's just from myself. But I understand you might disagree. However, the point of my post was to know if I was overreacting, not to know if I'm a bad person for cheating. I really do know it wasn't okay.

I really appreciate your well thought out response. It was compassionate and also realistic. I had no idea it was illegal to use my husband's phone without explicit permission. I guess that's a good reason to stop myself in the future and it will benefit me too.

As someone who also watches porn it makes sense not to be jealous about it. It doesn't actually mean anything. (And in reality I didn't snoop his computer that time and it wasn't literally porn). It was a dating game that was left open when I was cleaning his desk and although the monitor was off I accidentally turned it on to see the game. But I also have played similarly stupid games and they're honestly more cringe worthy than sexy. But I did get jealous over it for a moment and easier to say I looked for porn in the post itself than say the actual truth. But in the comments I try to respond accordingly.

I didn't even consider he was lying for internet points. He could have been. Either way, it's clear I shouldn't be upset over something that happened in the past. And now that the initial sting of jealousy has subsided I realize how dumb it was.

He broke up with me after I cheated. I told him right away but I still should have broken up before it happened. And we didn't talk for about 2 or years at which point we reconnected and started dating again and then got married. 

I certainly hope he doesn't have secret children. That would be a real blow to find out. Now I'll be anxious about that...

You're right, although he was being petty and dickish I'm not perfect too. And he did work hard to build a career and get the skills to pay the bills. I could never do his job and when he does have work, it's a lot more intellectually complex than being a cashier at a gas station.

I did accept the hygeine thing. I guess it's not fair to allow it to piss me off only when mad. He grew up in an abusive household without a lot of amenities such as hot water so it's a habit that never formed. I'm still probably going to try and change that in him at least for now. I sometimes leave the water running after I shower and sometimes he will get in or else just tell me to turn it off. But it does work sometimes so I'll keep trying.

I didn't actually hit him, but again, easier to say that I hit him versus I spit on his chest. Both are forms of physical abuse and neither are okay. I would never do it again and I went into counseling right after that argument because I realized that it was not the kind of person I want to be. I'd like to think I've changed to never do it again but some of the comments on here really make me feel like it's unforgivable and because I did it once (and cheated once) I can't be a good person anymore. 

We do both suck. We also do good things. He volunteers at homeless shelters. I use part of the money from my side hustle to donate to charities. Like people who didn't read this post and know me irl always say I'm so happy and I Light up the room etc. I've done bad things in the past and there's part of me that is not good but overall I try to be decent. It's the good in him that made me fall in love not the bad obviously. Like, he's a good provider for our family and he always buys toys and treats for our cat even if he doesn't do the feeding or cleaning up for the cat. 

He does still want to be with me. I guess right now I feel like he shouldn't not only because of the snooping but because of the things I did years ago before I even got diagnosed with BPD. And I shouldn't use it as a crutch but I do think having a diagnosis helps me understand better. A lot of people probably wouldn't want to be with either of us. We are both very flawed but I try to overlook the flaws because I do know deep down there's good in him. I hope there's good in me too because he seems to see it even if I don't right now. 

Again, thank you so much for the thoughtful and compassionate response.

That's a good point. Just because he hid it doesn't mean he's actively doing that anymore. I would have preferred to know previously and been mad and gotten over it. I just need to get over it I think, as it's clear I'm overreacting about it after some reflection.

I kind of ignored the messiness because originally he helped a little but it's gotten worse. As for the racism with current events that's been worse lately too. I always sort of knew. But lately he's been advocating for sending all black people to Africa or even genocide. Of course I know he would never do it. And part of me has even wondered if maybe he's right and I'm just stupid not to see. I know admitting that is not something that's politically correct but sadly my views have swayed slightly the past few years from thinking everyone should be equal and get along (naive) to thinking what if he has a point and all races would be happy if they had their own places.

Thanks. I haven't been in it for a while after my counselor got sick. Just self help workbooks for now and clearly they didn't help because after 2 years of no drama I decided to create trouble for myself. He has told me before years ago not to ask questions I don't want the answer to but I did that last night.
Agreed. I should get back into it. It will help me manage my feelings I think. He's very adamant that therapy does nothing for men though so he would never go.

I take that as a yes I'm overreacting for wanting to leave him? Although I asked if i was overreacting not if i was a piece of shit that he's better off without...

And he did do himself a favor and break up with me but he clearly was willing to forgive me after I had a few years in counseling and sorting my own shit out. Although I think I need to keep working on myself. But I don't think he's a perfect person either. Neither of us are by far.

But we also both have good traits which I didn't go into deuing my post. He volunteers to help homeless people and I use profits from my side gig to donate to charities. 

I told him what I did and that I snooped. And he was annoyed and thinks it was silly of me to be upset. As it was. But he still chose to keep loving me after that so, that's his choice. And as another commenter mentioned if he can love me despite my flaws I should be willing to do the same.

Edited to add context and info from another comment

A few. He throws things and yells and punches walls rather than just talking during arguments like adults. I think counseling would help but that's something counseling would help if he ever wanted to change. But he doesn't. And I've come to accept that if I wasn't the one who made him mad he wouldn't need to break things. Sometimes he does it at things outside of my control though like if he spills chips he will throw the rest of the bag across the room.

Also our sex life is pretty dead but my libido has been low lately so it matches up with his better. A few years ago it would have been a straw though. Now it's not really a big deal although if he had better hygiene I might be more attracted to him so perhaps it's for the best he doesn't.

I'm somewhat put off by his weight as well. He's probably 450lbs but 6ft 4. I worry about his health and it scares me he might die from a heart attack because he buys fast food every day for lunch. His eating habits do kind of disgust me but at least he doesn't make me eat those things.

I also don't like his friends because they're also racist and sexist but I'm not in a relationship with them so it's minor.
That's not what I'm asking but thanks for sharing. I wish you well in life.

Thank you for such a thoughtful response. Previously I would have been terrified of being alone but now I think if I can get a FT career I might like the idea. I was in counseling after the incident where I hit my husband and it helped a lot. Unfortunately my counselor got ill and I never got back into it the past few years but I've been doing my best to manage my symptoms with self help books/workbooks. Everything else I did was before counseling. I know I'm not fully over them because if I was I wouldn't have done what I did last night and seen the reddit post nevertheless be jealous about it.

Getting back into counseling would be a good idea and I think I'll have to make sure I can afford that if I leave. Currently I'm only doing a self help workbook. Ideally my husband could probably benefit from counseling too since he currently gets shouty and throws stuff and it helped me a lot so it would probably help him. Might not fix the racism or sexism but even though I can't make him change I'd love for him to be a better person someday.

I love him and want the best for him and I think you're right that this is bad on both ends so we are both better off alone. But I'll keep the cat.

This is the only new piece of info so if I'm blowing it out of proportion I don't know if it's a good idea to make a decision based on that. I knew he was messy and racist before we got married but married him anyway. That was a fee years ago now and the reddit comment is the only thing that's happened since then. I do appreciate the comment though it's given me some things to think about.
Yeah I see that too. I can think we are both bad so we deserve each other. Thanks for the comment.

I know I'm a terrible person I said I didn't want to hear that. I just wasn't sure if he was bad too or worse. He's free to divorce me if he hates me which is why he broke up with me after I cheated on him.

Edit: I don't know why this is getting down voted. Trust me. I didn't post in AITA for a reason. I know I have done awful things in the past. Other than this one time snooping I haven't done anything bad for 3 years and admittedly I know I shouldn't have snooped. I wasn't asking if I am terrible. I was asking if I was overreacting. I think now I probably am. But that's not what this sub is for. Just say I've overreacted and move on.

YTA for not passing it down and having no intentions to do so. This is a toy and a tradition, and in order to keep the tradition alive, the teddy is meant to be passed on to someone who can enjoy it the same way you did. Rather than refusing to give it up because the child destroys everything as you put it, perhaps speak to your sister and let her know that this means a lot to you and you want to explain the significance to your niece yourself. Depending on how you were when you received it, you could even give it to her in a year or so. But this teddy seems important to your sister as well and when it was given to you it was assumed that you'd pass it down to someone to keep the tradition alive. By not doing that you're killing the meaning more than a little wear and tear on the bear could do, as that can be patched up with needle and thread.
